slides.title: What is happening to Addis Standard?
February: registration revoked
slides.body: The Ethiopian Media Authority revoked its online registration on Feb 24, 2026, saying it spread reports that compromise media ethics. The editor says it got no formal notice.

slides.title: August: editor held, office searched
slides.body: The publisher says editor-in-chief Yonas Kedir was held about 24 hours on Aug 1 and equipment was seized from its Addis Ababa office on Aug 2.

slides.title: What is still unknown
slides.body: CPJ says the Justice Ministry and Government Communication Service did not immediately respond. The publisher's account is not independently verified.

slides.title: Press freedom and fair legal process matter.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
